vector_add.ir_text:
entry:       fn_entry   vector_add(ptr %A, ptr %B, ptr %C, i32 %N)       ; Kernel entry point
             br         label %loop.cond                                 ; Enter loop header
loop.cond:   phi        i32 [%i, %loop.inc], [0, %entry]                 ; Induction variable i = 0
             icmp_slt   %cmp = icmp slt i32 %i, %N                       ; Check i < N
             br_cond    i1 %cmp, label %loop.body, label %exit           ; Branch to body or exit
loop.body:   gep        %ptr.a = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %A, i32 %i ; Compute &A[i] address
             load       float %val.a = load float, ptr %ptr.a, align 4   ; DRAM read A[i]
             gep        %ptr.b = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %B, i32 %i ; Compute &B[i] address
             load       float %val.b = load float, ptr %ptr.b, align 4   ; DRAM read B[i]
             fadd       float %res = fadd float %val.a, %val.b           ; Floating point add (NMC ALU / CPU ALU)
             gep        %ptr.c = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %C, i32 %i ; Compute &C[i] address
             store      store float %res, ptr %ptr.c, align 4            ; DRAM write C[i]
             br         label %loop.inc                                  ; Branch to increment
loop.inc:    add        i32 %i.next = add nuw nsw i32 %i, 1              ; i = i + 1
             br         label %loop.cond                                 ; Loop back
exit:        ret        void                                             ; Function return

analysis.memory_access_pattern: 2D Row-Major Matrix Scan + Repeated Vector Broadcast

gemv.ir_text:
entry:       fn_entry   gemv(ptr %A, ptr %X, ptr %Y, i32 %N, i32 %M)     ; Matrix-Vector kernel
             br         label %outer.cond                                ; Enter outer loop
outer.cond:  phi        i32 [%i, %outer.inc], [0, %entry]                ; Outer row index i = 0
             icmp_slt   %cmp.i = icmp slt i32 %i, %N                     ; Check i < N
             br_cond    i1 %cmp.i, label %inner.init, label %exit        ; Branch to row
inner.init:  phi        float [%sum, %inner.inc], [0.0, %outer.cond]     ; Row accumulator = 0.0
             phi        i32 [%j, %inner.inc], [0, %outer.cond]           ; Col index j = 0
             icmp_slt   %cmp.j = icmp slt i32 %j, %M                     ; Check j < M
             br_cond    i1 %cmp.j, label %inner.body, label %row.store   ; Branch to MAC
inner.body:  mul_add    %idx = mul i32 %i, %M; %off = add i32 %idx, %j   ; Row-major index i*M + j
             gep        %ptr.a = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %A, i32 %off ; Address &A[i][j]
             load       float %val.a = load float, ptr %ptr.a, align 4   ; DRAM read A[i][j]
             gep        %ptr.x = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %X, i32 %j ; Address &X[j]
             load       float %val.x = load float, ptr %ptr.x, align 4   ; Vector read X[j]
             fmul       float %prod = fmul float %val.a, %val.x          ; Multiply A[i][j] * X[j]
             fadd       float %sum.next = fadd float %sum, %prod         ; Accumulate row dot-product
             br         label %inner.inc                                 ; Increment inner
inner.inc:   add        i32 %j.next = add nuw nsw i32 %j, 1              ; j = j + 1
             br         label %inner.init                                ; Inner loop back
row.store:   gep        %ptr.y = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %Y, i32 %i ; Address &Y[i]
             store      store float %sum, ptr %ptr.y, align 4            ; Store result Y[i]
             br         label %outer.inc                                 ; Branch to outer inc
outer.inc:   add        i32 %i.next = add nuw nsw i32 %i, 1              ; i = i + 1
             br         label %outer.cond                                ; Outer loop back
exit:        ret        void                                             ; Function return
